newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Campbell Soup upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Campbell Soup upgraded.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan Securities said analyst Erika Gritman Long upgraded Campbell Soup Co to buy from market performer.

-- Campbell's is cutting costs and investing in brands to drive volumes; the market should favor high-quality consumer staple stocks in 1997; and the stock has lagged the market, the analyst said in a report.
-- Set a $95 12-month price target on the stock, which was down 1/2 at 81-3/8.
